answer.summary: You can update your Aadhaar address either completely online using your registered mobile number for OTP verification, or offline by booking an appointment at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra in Karnataka. Address-only updates do not require biometric changes if you have valid supporting proof.
steps: Choose your update method: fully online via the Self Service Update Portal or offline by booking an appointment at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
If updating online, visit the official MyAadhaar portal (myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in) and log in using your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
Select 'Update Aadhaar Online' and choose 'Address' from the list of demographic details you wish to modify.
Enter your new address details carefully, ensuring the spelling and Pincode match your supporting document exactly.
Upload a scanned copy or clear photograph of a valid Address Proof (PoA) document that contains your new address.
Pay the applicable service fee online through net banking, credit/debit card, or UPI if required.
Submit your request and note down the Update Request Number (URN) generated to track the status of your application.
If updating offline, book an appointment at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centre via the UIDAI website, and carry your original documents for verification.
required_documents: Valid Proof of Address (PoA) supporting the new address (such as utility bill, bank statement, passport, or ration card)
answer.fees: Free for initial enrolment and demographic updates, though standard kiosk or portal processing fees may apply for specific services.
answer.processing_time: Updates typically reflect within 1 to 90 days from the date of submission.
answer.office_or_portal: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in or nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Karnataka One centre
tips: Make sure your current mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar to receive the OTP required for online authentication.
Keep your Update Request Number (URN) safe to easily check the progress of your address modification online.

location_result.address: Search for your nearest UIDAI (via Aadhaar Seva Kendra/enrolment centre) via uidai.gov.in
